answer: An attester must stake 39% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the mesa stake is held until the dawn settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the hollow audit lists each exposure. A farm running 113 keys therefore burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
